name: The Dolomites, Italy
description: Jagged limestone peaks rising abruptly from lush emerald meadows in South Tyrol. An alpine wonderland known for its legendary via ferratas, secluded rifugios, and ethereal enrosadira alpenglow.
bestTimeToVisit: Late June to late September for hiking; January to March for ski touring
highlights: Circumnavigating the iconic Tre Cime di Lavaredo at sunrise
Overnight stay at Rifugio Lagazuoi watching sunset clouds
Tasting homemade canederli and wild blueberry strudel
Traversing high-altitude ridge paths on the Alta Via 1
